Title: Arrival flight: UA 190
Details: Land 8:25 AM local. Clear customs and head to Leonardo Express train to Termini.

Title: Check in: Hotel Artemide
Details: Early check-in from 2:30 PM. Rooftop bar opens at 5 PM — good for jetlag recovery.

Title: Vatican City & St. Peter's Basilica
Details: Timed entry — arrive 30 min early. Shoulders covered for both of you.

Title: Colosseum, Forum, Palatine Hill
Details: Combined ticket. Enter via the Forum side — shorter line.

Title: Check out of Hotel Artemide
Details: Late checkout until noon already arranged.

Title: SIXT rental car pickup
Details: ZTL test day. Driver: Kim. Navigate around historic center ZTL cameras — use autostrada A1 north.

Title: Check in: Loggiato dei Serviti
Details: Park at Garage La Stazione (outside ZTL). Walk 8 min with luggage.

Title: Uffizi Gallery — timed entry
Details: Renaissance marathon. Save 2 hours. Botticelli room midway.

Title: Galleria dell'Accademia (The David)
Details: Afternoon slot — far less crowded than morning.

Title: SIXT car return — Florence
Details: Return with full tank. Then walk to train platform.

Title: Frecciarossa to Venezia S. Lucia
Details: Carriage 4, seats 22A/22B. 2h 5min. Validate ticket if printed.

Title: Water taxi + check in: Palazzo Stern
Details: Take Vaporetto Line 1 from Ferrovia to Ca' Rezzonico. Palazzo is 2-min walk.

Title: Doge's Palace / Palazzo Ducale
Details: Advance purchase €25 (booked >30 days ahead). Secret Itineraries tour highly recommended.

Title: Check out: Palazzo Stern
Details: Leave bags at reception if needed.

Title: Water taxi to Venice Marco Polo (VCE)
Details: Alilaguna from San Marco — Blue Line goes to VCE. ~1h 15min. Arrive airport 2h before flight.

Title: Return flight: UA 191
Details: Departure 4:55 PM local. Arrive EWR 9:45 PM EDT.

Title: Armando al Pantheon
Details: Stanley Tucci came here for pasta. Tiny and famous — book ahead.

Title: Piazza Navona + Four Rivers Fountain
Details: Best at night — the fountain is illuminated.

Title: Ristoro degli Angeli
Details: GF tiramisu. Fried zucchini blossoms stuffed with mozzarella and anchovies.

Title: Domus Aurea
Details: Nero's palace — VR-guided tour. Also a cat sanctuary. Book in advance.

Title: Cimarra 4 Pizzeria & Cocktail Bar
Details: GF-friendly Roman pizza. Casual.

Title: Centro Storico + Pantheon + Trevi Fountain
Details: Go early morning (before 8) — empty and magical.

Title: Janiculum Hill panorama
Details: Time it for the noon cannon shot. Golden hour: Giardini degli Aranci on Aventine.

Title: Glass Hostaria
Details: Michelin-starred tasting menu in Trastevere.

Title: Osteria dello Sgrano
Details: GF pasta — the reason to come. Book for 8 PM.

Title: Antica Gelateria Fiorentina
Details: GF cones!

Title: Duomo di Firenze — climb the dome
Details: 463 steps. Not for the claustrophobic. Book early morning slot.

Title: Le Volpi e l'Uva
Details: Wine from all over Italy plus local varietals. Cheese plates.

Title: Risotteria Melotti Firenze
Details: Risotto-only spot. Reservations essential.

Title: Day trip: Siena or San Gimignano
Details: 1hr drive each way. ZTL in Siena — park outside walls at Parcheggio Il Campo.

Title: 5ecinque — Natural Vegetarian
Details: Seasonal, organic, everything house-made.

Title: Piazza San Marco + St. Mark's Basilica
Details: Free entry to basilica but queues are brutal. Skip-the-line ticket worth it.

Title: Osteria alle Testiere
Details: Tiny seafood spot. Two seatings only — book weeks ahead.

Title: Burano + Torcello day trip
Details: Vaporetto Line 12 from Fondamente Nove. ~45 min each way. Bring the multi-day pass.

Title: Peggy Guggenheim Collection
Details: 5-min walk from hotel. Small but fantastic modern art.
